run_rerank_cli: run the noisychannel reranking CLI to rescore and select best translation hypotheses
run_rerank_function: run the rerank function to generate n-best lists and select best hypotheses via rescoring
run_score_target_hypo: run score_target_hypo to compute weighted scores and BLEU for translation hypotheses
run_match_target_hypo: run match_target_hypo to combine LM and bitext scores and select the best hypothesis
run_load_score_files: run load_score_files to load precomputed rescoring outputs from disk for all shards
